key_insight: ScoutRoute uses internal signals from one inexpensive language model to predict which expert model is best suited to a task.
engineering_relevance: The framework supports lightweight, post-hoc routing across independently trained language models without modifying the underlying models.
method: Run a single forward pass through an inexpensive scout model.
Apply lightweight logistic probes to hidden states to estimate expert competence.
Combine competence estimates with logit-derived confidence in a domain-aware routing strategy.
evidence_signal: Across five open-weight models and four benchmarks spanning math, code, commonsense, and multidisciplinary knowledge, ScoutRoute reportedly outperformed individual routing signals, while its competence probes showed better calibration than conventional confidence measures.
watch_item: The abstract does not quantify routing gains or end-to-end latency savings, leaving deployment benefits uncertain.
paper_title: ScoutRoute: Efficient Mixture-of-Experts Routing Using Internal Language Model Signals
